summary: Introduces `ansible.cfg` as the configuration file for adjustable settings, noting the stock configuration suits most users and that search paths are listed in the reference docs.
questions: Do I need to change ansible.cfg to use Ansible?

answer_card.title: The ansible.cfg configuration file
answer_card.answer_md: Some Ansible settings are adjustable through a configuration file, `ansible.cfg`. The stock configuration is enough for most users, but you can change it when needed. The paths where Ansible searches for the file are listed in the reference documentation.
